name: fix inter-script dependencies and directory setup for a chained pipeline
definition: Ensure referenced helper scripts, paths, and an output directory resolve so stages can run in sequence.
failure_mode: Broken references or a missing directory abort the run.

name: keep the global environment footprint bounded
definition: Repair the environment so the size of the shared site-packages does not grow beyond a fraction of baseline.
failure_mode: a heavy install makes the size swing violates the bound
